text.body: śrīḥ śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite nyāyakalāpasaṅgrahaḥ praṇamya rāmānuja saṃyamīśvaraṃ prabodhahetuṃ hṛdayāmbujanmanaḥ | karomi taddarśanamārgagocaraṃ śārīrakanyāyakalāpasaṃgraham || 1 || pramāṇatā tatpratiyogibhaṅgaḥ saṃrādhanaṃ tasya phalopabhogaḥ | etāni samyak paricintitāni śāstre tvihādhyāya catuṣṭayena || 2 || aspaṣṭataram aspaṣṭaṃ spaṣṭaṃ chāyānusāri ca | jīvapradhānayoḥ ādau vākyajātaṃ vicintitam || 3 || smṛtinyāyāvirodhaśca parapakṣaparāhatiḥ | kāryatā viyadādīnāṃ akṣādeśca dvitīyataḥ || 4|| sadoṣatvaṃ adoṣatvaṃ jīvasya ca parasya ca | tṛtīyena paropāstiḥ itikartavyatā'pi ca || 5 || upāstyanuṣṭhānavidhā gatyupakrama eva ca | gatimārga prakāraśca phalaṃ cāpi caturthataḥ || 6 || prathama pādaḥ kārye hi vṛddhavyavahāra siddho vyutpatatibhāvo vacasāṃ, na siddhe | ityetadutsāritavān prasiddheḥ siddhe'pi bālapratibodhaneṣu || 7 || bhedaprasakteranubhūtyabhāvāt viśeṣaṇaṃ vā'pyupalakṣaṇaṃ vā | janmādyaśakyapratipādanaṃ yat syāttannirāso'pyubhayatva śakteḥ || 8 || kāryatvataḥ sāvayavattva siddhāt kartā ca saṃsiddhyati kāraṇaṃ ca | ityetadutsāritavān pradūṣya śāstraikagamyatva samarthanena || 9 || prayojanaṃ brahmaṇi naiva labdhaṃ siddhe pravṛttistvathavā nivṛttiḥ | ityapramātvaṃ hi viśaṅkya nunnaṃ svataḥ phalatvena parasya puṃsaḥ || 10 || vyutpattyabhāvāt pratipattidaussthyāt anyena siddheraphalatvataśca | amātvamāśaṅkya nirācakāra nyāyaiścaturbhiḥ pratipādya tattat || 11 || gauṇī tu gauṇekṣaṇa sāhacaryāt īkṣā yatastajjagatāṃ nidānam | pradhānaṃ ityedapācakāra mukhyaṃ yato vīkṣaṇaṃ ātmaśabdāt || 12 || vikāravācī mayaḍityamuṣmāt kṣetrajñamānandamayaṃ viśaṅkya | asaṃbhavāt prāṇamaye ca hāneḥ prācuryavācīti nirācakāra || 13 || dehitvataścetana eva kaścit puṇyottaro maṇḍalamadhyavartī | ityevamutsārayate sma śaṅkāṃ lokeśatādyaiḥ paramātmadharmaiḥ || 14 || ākāśa ityeva viśeṣanāmnā sa va tu syāt jagatāṃ nidānam | prāṇo'thavetyetadapācakāra bhūtābhisaṃveśamukhaiśca liṅgaiḥ || 15 || na hi svavākye paraliṅgadharmāḥ jyotistu tadbhūtatṛtīyameva | etanna śaṅkyaṃ, na hi tasya pādo bhūtāni kintvasya parasya puṃsaḥ || 16 || indre tu nirdhārita jīvabhāve svopāsti śabdāt sa hi kāraṇaṃ syāt | etanna sat, tasya hi śāstradṛṣṭyā tathopadeśo'mṛtatā ca dharmaḥ || 17 || sarjñamānandamayaṃ sarūpaṃ tejasvinaṃ prāṇanakāraṇaṃ ca | susthānamātmānamudājahāra pādena pūrveṇa jagannidānam || 18 || śāstre tvamuṣmin jagatāṃ nidānaṃ brahmaiva sākṣāt cidaciccharīram | ityevamarthaṃ viśadīkariṣyan pādān atha trīn pracakāra śeṣān || 19 || tatra dvitīyena śarīram āsīt tatpratyaśeṣaḥ cidacitprapañcaḥ | tṛtīyatastasya tadātmabhāvaḥ caturthatastadviparītabhaṅgaḥ || 20 || svakarmataḥ kāraṇatābhiyogāt alpatvato'lpāyatanatvataśca | sarvaṃ samāśaṅkya nirāsa jīvaṃ prasiddhitastadguṇataḥ smṛteśca || 21 || attā tu jīvo na paraḥ svatantraḥ sa eva yatkarmaphalopabhogī | ityapyasat taddhi carācarasya mṛtyūpasekāt adanaṃ tvapītiḥ || 22 || akṣyantarastveṣa iti prasiddhyā jīvo'thavā bimbam athāpi daivam | ityapyasat syāt amṛtatvaśabdāt sukhaśruteścāpyanavasthiteśca || 23 || draṣṭeti śabdāt iha vākyaśeṣe draṣṭrantarasya pratiṣedhataśca | kṣetrajñamantaryamayantamāhetyetanna jāgartyamṛtatvaśabdāt || 24 || sthūlatvadṛśyatva niṣedhanena sūkṣmaṃ tvadṛśyatvaguṇaṃ pradhānam | kṣetrajña evākṣara mityasat syāt pratijñayā tatparataḥ paratvāt || 25 || kaukṣeyavahnistvatha devatā vā bhūtaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tvathavā'gniśabdāt | vaiśvānaraḥ syāt iti, naiva yasmāt trailokyadehaḥ puruṣābhidhā ca || 26 || sthūlasya sūkṣmasya tathendriyāṇāṃ ekaikaśaścāvayavatvataśca | taddehatāṃ saṃpratipādya paścāt tadanyadehatvaṃ apācakāra || 27 || pādenetthaṃ anenārthāt jagataḥ taccharīratā | sāmānādhikaraṇyena tadanyena ca sādhitā || 28 || tṛtīya pādaḥ manaḥ prabhṛtyakṣasamāśrayatvāt dyubhvāśrayaḥ cetana eva nānyaḥ | evaṃ na śaṅkyaṃ sphuṭaṃ ātmaśabdāt muktopasṛpya vyapadeśataśca || 29 || nāmādyupakramya kṛtopadeśaḥ samāpitaḥ prāṇananāmni jīve | tataḥ sa bhūmeti na śaṅkanīyaṃ satyopadeśāt adhikaṃ tvamuṣmāt || 30 || avyākṛtaṃ cetana eva vāpi syādakṣaraṃ cāspadam ambarasya | kāryāspadatvāt acidāśrayatvāt ityapyasat tasya dhṛteḥ praśāsteḥ || 31 || bhuvo'ntarikṣāt adhikopadiṣṭo yo brahmalokaḥ sa vidhātṛlokaḥ | tatra trimātrapraṇavānucintyo dhātetyasat syāt amṛtābhidhādyaiḥ || 32 || dahrastu khaṃ syāt atha cetano vā prasiddhiyogāt guṇayogataśca | na sādhvidaṃ khe na hi satyabhāvaḥ kāmāśca jīve na nisargasiddhāḥ || 33 || "prāṇādhipaḥ sañcaratī"ti vākye prasiddhito'ṅguṣṭhamito hi jīvaḥ | ityapyasādhveva bhavet amuṣmin īśānaśabdaśravaṇāddhi vākye || 34 || avigrahā vigrahavatprasādhye saṃrādhane nādhikṛtāstu devāḥ | ityapyasat kalpita nāmarūpāḥ tasmāt manuṣyā iva te'pi śaktāḥ || 35|| madhvādividyāsvadhikārabhājaḥ vasvādayo naiva vasutvayogāt | upāsyabhāvāt iti naiva yasmāt bhūyo'pi vāñchā'sti paro hyupāsyaḥ || 36 || svādhyāyahīnā api bhāratādīn śrutvā'tha vijñāya paraṃ pumāṃsam | upāsate śūdragaṇā itīdaṃ na sat, niṣedhāt śravaṇādikasya || 37 || dhūtveti vākye prakṛtastu pūrvam ākāśatāṃ ṛcchatu mukta eva | etanna hi prāṇiti nāmarūpa nirvāhakau naiva hi baddhamuktau || 38 || akliṣṭabhāvaḥ sukharūpatā ca praśāsitṛtvaṃ śrayaṇīyatā ca | guṇottaratvaṃ tvajugupsatā ca nirvoḍhṛtā ca pratipāditā'smin || 39 || pradhāna jīvayoḥ vyaṣṭyoḥ samaṣṭyoścā''tmatā kramāt | uktā tṛtīye tu punaḥ tasyāḥ śāsanatā'pi ca || 40 || caturthapañcamābhyāṃ tu svarūpeṇa guṇairapi | upāsyatārthaṃ ātmatvaṃ ityātmatvaprayojanam || 41 || heye'pi tattatsambandhe naiveśatvāt jugupsate | iti nyāyena ṣaṣṭhena proktam ātmatvasiddhaye || 42 || madhye prasaṅgāt ṣaṣṭhasya devadeva viśeṣayoḥ | vidyādhikāraḥ śūdrāṇāṃ tadabhāvaśca sādhitaḥ || saptamāt īśitṛtvaṃ tu nirvoḍhṛtvāt sthirīkṛtam || 43 || evaṃ etaiḥ tribhiḥ pādaiḥ kāraṇaṃ brahma sādhitam | caturthāt tacca hetutvaṃ tasyaiveti prasādhyate || 44 || caturtha pādaḥ avyaktaṃ mahataḥ paraṃ tu puruṣaḥ tasmāt paraḥ tatparaṃ naivāstīti kutantra siddhagaṇanā tatprakriyānusmṛteḥ | etannaiva yathārthamatra rathatādyukteṣu vāgādikeṣu avyaktaṃ tu śarīrameva puruṣaḥ so'yaṃ paraḥ pūruṣaḥ || 45 || "ajāṃ" ityetasmin vacasi gaditaṃ tanvagaditaṃ pradhānaṃ svātantryāt sakalajagatī sargakaraṇāt | idaṃ naivaitasmin khalu sṛjatimātraṃ tvabhihitaṃ viśeṣasyābhāvāt vadati ca viśeṣaṃ śrutirataḥ || 46 || "yasmin pañcajanāśca pañca gaganaṃ cāpī"ti vākye sphuṭaṃ saṃkhyāsaṃgrahaṇāt tu tantragaṇanetyetanna hi prāṇiti | brahmādhāratayā sthiteratiśayasphūrteśca saṃjñātvataḥ prāṇādīndriyapañcakasya ca yathā sapteti saptarṣayaḥ || 47 || kvacit sat kvāpyātmā kvacit asadapi kvāpi puruṣaḥ kvacit brahmetyevaṃ vividhavacanāt hetuvacasām | na nirṇītiḥ kvāpi tviti na khalu, sarvatra hi paraḥ samākṛṣṭo liṅgaprakaraṇaguṇādyairiti yataḥ || 48 || "yaḥ kartā yasya karme"tyabhihitapuruṣo jīva evātra vṛttaḥ kartṛtvāt karmavatvāt sahaja nijaguṇaiḥ bhoktṛbhāvapratīteḥ | ityevaṃ naiva śaṅkyaṃ jagadiha vacane karmaśabdābhidheyaṃ dṛṣṭyarthaṃ prāṇajīvagrahaṇamiha suṣuptyāśrayo brahma yasmāt || 49 || patyādīnāṃ priyatvaṃ svakṛtamiti vacasyatra jīvo'bhidheyaḥ draṣṭavyatvena yasmāt śrutamiha patipatnyādi sambandha bhāktvam | naivānyasmin hi vākyānvayanaṃ amṛtatā hetubhāvastathoktaḥ vākyānte jīvaliṅgaśravaṇamidamavasthānato'ntaḥ parasya || 50 || upādānāt anyat tvitaraditi naikatraghaṭanā vikāritvābhāvaśravaṇamapi jāgarti bhuvane | ato nopādānaṃ para iti na śakyaṃ kathayitum pratijñānāt sākṣāt ubhayakathanāt kiṃsviditi ca || 51 || prakriyā pratyabhijñānāt svabhāvakathanāt tathā | saṃkhyopasaṃgrahācāpi vyākulatvāt parasparam || 52 || karmasambandhakathanāt patyādi śravaṇāt tathā | loke ca bhedasandṛṣṭeḥ upādānanimittayoḥ || 53 || brahmaiva kāraṇaṃ nānyat ityeṣā naiva niścitiḥ | iti yat tāntrikeṣūktaṃ tadanena nirākṛtam || 54 || tribhiḥ pradhānasya nirākṛtiḥ syāt caturthato'nyonya virodhabhaṅgaḥ | mukiṃta gato bandhagataśca jīvo vyāvartitaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhakābhyām || 55 || etāvatā sūtrakalāpakena nirīśvaraṃ sāṃkhyaṃ apācakāra | śeṣāt dhunoti sma sa ceśvaraṃ tat aikyaṃ nimitteśvarayoḥ samicchan || 56 || evaṃ jagatkāraṇavādivākyaiḥ uktaṃ samastairapi caikakaṇṭhaiḥ | brahmaiva sarvajñamanantaśakti nidānameṣāṃ jagatāmitīdam || 57 || sūkṣmacidaciccharīraṃ kāraṇatāṃ yāti tat paraṃ brahma | sthūlacidaciccharīraṃ punaśca tat kāryatāṃ yāti || 58 || prathama pādaḥ smṛtervirodhādupabṛṃhaṇasya na brahma heturjagatāmitīdam | asāramanyasmṛtibhirvirodhāt teṣāṃ tvanāptiśca na śakyaśaṅkā || 1 || brahmeti vedāntasamarthito'rthaḥ tatseśvara smṛtyanusārahāneḥ | asādhvitīdaṃ na, parairvirodhāt jīvatvato vibhramasaṃbhavācca || 2 || yadyatkāryaṃ na tattatpratibhaṭaguṇakaṃ brahma cedaṃ ca viśvam | jñātvājñatvādi dharmaiḥ pratibhayamatha cedīkṣaṇāccetanatvam || 3 || tattāsāṃ devatānāmiti tu na caturaṃ dṛśyate makṣikādeḥ | kṛmyādi dravyabhedo yadi na bhavati tatkāryahetvoralaṃ syāt || 4 || bhoktṛtvaṃ syājjīvavaddehavattvāt ityetasmānnādhikaṃ brahma siddhyet | naitacchaṅkyaṃ muktavatkarmahāneḥ yujyetaitat rājavaccāpi loke || 5 || buddhyākārābhidhāna vyavahṛtigaṇanairbhedakaiḥ kāryahetvoḥ ekatvaṃ naiva sidhyet iti tu na caturaṃ kārakānarthatā ca | sadbrahmātmādi śabdairabhihitamapṛthagyena śabdādibhedo dravyāvasthāvalaṃbī tata iha na bhavet kārakānarthatā ca || 6 || jīvasya brahmabhāvaṃ vyapadiśati yatastattvamasyādivākyaṃ tasmādduḥkhaikakandaṃ na hi sṛjati jagat kaḥ svaduḥkhābhilāṣī | naivaitadyena bhedaṃ prakaṭayati tayoranya ityādi vākyaṃ dehātmatvādi bhedaśravaṇamapi yathā cetanaikyopadeśaḥ || 7 || yatkāraṇaṃ kārakasevyapakṣaṃ tatsyāt paraṃ brahma na tadvyapekṣam | ato na hetustviti naiva yasmāt kṣīraṃ tu naivecchati tat dadhitve || 8 || brahma syāt kāryaśeṣaṃ nikhilamavayavābhāvataḥ sāṃśatā cet vyākopaḥ syādidānīmavayavaviraha śrāviṇīnāṃ śrutīnām | hetutvaṃ tasya tasmāt vihatamubhayathetyetadapyāttasāraṃ vailakṣaṇyātprakārācchatibhirapi tathā jñāpanācchaktimattvāt || 9 || kāmānāṃ samavāptito na hi phalaṃ kiñcit samālokyate sṛṣṭerasya parasya nāpi dayayā duḥkhaikahetutvataḥ | naivaitat sa hi līlayaiva tanute puṇyādyapekṣāvaśāt vaiṣamyādi ca nāsti karmavaśatā siddheranāditvataḥ || 10 || kapilasmṛtervirodhāt hiraṇyagarbhasmṛte rvirodhācca | nyāyavirodhāt bhogaprasaṅgataḥ kāryahetubhedācca || 11 || jīvabrahmaikatvāt kārakasaṃgrahaṇahānitaścāpi | kāryaikaśeṣabhāvāt phalahāneścotthitaṃ tu paryaharat || dvābhyāṃ smṛtyavirodhaḥ syāt śeṣairnyāyāvirodhitā | caturthapañcamau tatra tṛtīyoktau prasaṃgataḥ || 12 || tasmāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca pāde'smin saṃgate mate | ṣaṣṭhādayastu catvāraḥ saṃgacchante yathākramam || 13 || tacchāyavākyairutthānaṃ tathā nyāyena codgamaḥ | iti pūrveṇa pādena saṃgatiḥ syāt suśobhanā || 14 || dvitīya pādaḥ vedāhṛtā yadyapi tattvasaṃkhyā jīvān bahūn icchati cāpi tantram | yatkāraṇaṃ tat khalu kartrapekṣaṃ naitattathā tāntrikamityasādhu || 15 || īśaśca kartā bahavaśca jīvāḥ tathā'pi na nyāyagatissamarthā | kāryānupāyādaṇubhirniraṃśaiḥ kāryatvato'rūpatayā ca teṣām || 16 || saṃghairaṇūnāṃ hi dharādayaḥ syuḥ dharādibhūtaiḥ karaṇādayaśca | ityapyasāraṃ kṣaṇikāḥ padārthāḥ kva saṃhatāḥ syuḥ kva ca kāryasiddhiḥ || 17 || ākāra ekastu vivādahāneḥ jñānasya nārthasya tataḥ sa nāsti | ityapyasat syāt tritayāvabhāsāt vijñānavat jñeyatadāśrayau ca || 18 || nityotpattiprasaṅgāt avikṛtabhavanaṃ nāma naivopapannaṃ naivāvasthānahāneḥ vikṛtabhavanamapyaśnute yuktimattām | tasmāttucchāt prabhūtaṃ bhuvanam iti na sadvastunaḥ kasyacitsyāt bhāvābhāvavyavasthā taditaraviṣaye tena tucchatvahāniḥ || 19 || sarvaṃ ca sattvādi paṭādibhāvaiḥ bhinnaṃ tvabhinnaṃ sthiramasthiraṃ ca | ityapyasat yena viruddhadharmau naikāśrayāvanyakṛtā pratītiḥ || 20 || patyuḥ paśūnāṃ matam ādarārhaṃ sarvajñabhāvācca parigrahācca | ityapyasat vedaviruddhadharmaparāvarādipratipādanena || 21 || jīvaḥ parasmāttu manastu jīvāt ityādibhiḥ vedavirodhadṛṣṭeḥ | syāt pañcarātraṃ na sat ityasāraṃ vyūhābhidhānāt pratiṣedhataśca || 22 || kapilakaṇabhugbuddhārhanto hatāḥ saha śaṃbhunā kuliśaniśitairetaistarkaiḥ akarkaśabuddhayaḥ | api ca bhagavaddṛṣṭā śrīpāñcarātragatistviyaṃ na khalu sadṛśī bāhyairanyairiti pratisādhitam || 23 || smṛtinyāyāvirodhaṃ ca parapakṣaparāhatim | vidhāya parato dvābhyāṃ kāryabhāvo vicintyate || 24 || tṛtīya pādaḥ utpattimanto na yathaiva jīvāḥ nabhaśca notpattimat aṃśahāneḥ | iti tvasāraṃ vadati śrutiścet tathaiva tat syāt na tu tarkabhaṅgaḥ || 25 || kāryāṇi sarvāṇi tathā śrutatvāt sthānāntarāt kāraṇato bhavanti | naivaṃ śruteravyavadhānadṛṣṭyā tattaccharīrāt parato bhavanti || 26 || "toyena jīvān" iti vākyabhāvāt pratijñayā jāyata eva jīvaḥ | idaṃ tvasāraṃ kṛtavipraṇāśaprasaṅgato "nitya" iti śruteśca || 27 || vijñānaśabdāt svapaneṣvadṛṣṭeḥ saṃjñānamāgantuka cetano vā | naivaṃ śruteḥ saṅkucitaṃ suṣuptau jñānābhidhā tadguṇasārataḥ syāt || 28 || nānyaṃ guṇetyādiṣu kartṛtā'sya niṣidhyate yena tato na kartā | ityetadevaṃ na viśaṅkanīyaṃ śāstrārthavattvāt upapattitaśca || 29 || kartṛtvaṃ etasya parānapekṣaṃ śāstrārthavattvāya sa hi svatantraḥ | naitat śrutibhyo na ca śāstrakopaḥ prayatnasāpekṣatayā parasya || 30 || bhedānna jīvoṃ'śa iti śrutīnāṃ dṛṣṭo virodhastvitaretareṇa | aṃśasmṛteḥ pādatayopadeśāt syādaṃśa evāsya parasya jīvaḥ || 31 || kāryatā viyadādīnāṃ tasyāścāvyavadhānatā | utpattyabhāvo jīvasya jñātṛtā kartṛtā'pi ca || 32 || kartṛtāyāḥ parāpekṣā paraṃ pratyaṃśatā'pi ca | itthamarthāstvamī sarve pādenānena cintitāḥ || 33 || prathamaśca dvitīyaśca tṛtīyaścātra saṅgatāḥ | tṛtīyaśeṣāścatvāraḥ prasaṅgāt tviha cintitāḥ || 34 || caturtha pādaḥ na hi jananaṃ indriyāṇāṃ prāṇā agre'bhavan iti śrutyā | naivaṃ prāṇastu paraḥ pratijñayā gauṇameva bahuvacanam || 35 || sapta tu yadeti vākyāt sapta prāṇā iti śruteścāpi | naivaṃ pradhānabhāvāt "daśema" iti vākyataḥ smaraṇāt || 36 || tāni tu vibhūni yuktaṃ "sarve'nantāḥ samā" iti śravaṇāt | naivamupāstyarthatvāt utkramaṇaśrutita eva cotkramaṇe || 37 || vākyāt prasiddheśca viśaṃkyate'yaṃ na vāyumātraṃ na ca tatkriyā vā | prāṇastu dehādibhṛdeva vāyuḥ prāṇasya vākyośca pṛthaktvaśabdāt || 38 || lokaiḥ tribhiḥ sāmyagirā vibhuḥ syāt prāṇastvitīdaṃ na viśaṅkanīyam | utkrānti śabdādibhirasya lokaiḥ sāmyaśrutiryā'va tathā'rthavādaḥ || 39 || vāgādyadhiṣṭhānam iha svataḥ syāt jīvena sārthaṃ jvalanādikānām | naivaṃ parātmāmananāt amīṣāṃ etattu "yo'gnau" iti ca śrutatvāt || 40 || prāṇābhidhānāt upakārasāmyāt ṣyeṣṭho'pi cāyaṃ sphuṭamindriyaṃ syāt | naitat "daśe"ti vyapadeśabhāvāt prāṇo manaścendriyamityataśca || 41 || nāmādisṛṣṭistu hiraṇyagarbhāt bhavet "anene"ti tu vākyabhāvāt | naivaṃ parādeva tu taccharīrāt seyaṃ trivṛtkāra samānakartuḥ || 42 || utpattyā saṃkhyānaṃ parimāṇaṃ caiva karaṇānām | prāṇasya ca svarūpaṃ parimāṇamanindriyatvaṃ ca || 43 || eteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ sargakaro vyaṣṭibhūtānām | ityetadakhilamamunā pādena vicintitaṃ samyak || 44 || prathame prasaktarūpāḥ pañcāpi vicintitā dvitīyādyāḥ | tasmāt saṅgatamasmin pāde prathamaṃ ca caramaṃ ca || 45 || prāṇasvarūpacintā prāṇatayā śabdanena karaṇānām | prāsaṅgikaprasiddhā prasaṅgatastadviśeṣacintā ca || 46 || aṇḍabahirbhūtānāṃ pūrveṇa vicintitā sṛṣṭiḥ | sṛṣṭistu cintitā syāt aṇḍāntarvartināmanenāpi || 47 || prathama pādaḥ na bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ saha yāti dehī tavaiva teṣāṃ sulabhatvahetoḥ | naivaivaṃ "āpa puruṣā bhavanti" ityevaṃ śrutatvāt saha taiḥ prayāti || 1 || "prāpyāntaṃ" ityādibhireva vākyaiḥ āyātu jīvo na tu karmaśeṣī | naitatphalaṃ karmanibandhanaṃ tu "kapūyacārā" iti ca śrutatvāt || 2 || "ye vai ca ke'pī" tyaviśeṣaśabdāt dhūmādikaṃ kevalapāpināṃ ca | iti tvasat syāt "atha ye"ti vākyāt puṇyāvalambī tu viśeṣaśabdaḥ || 3 || taddehatā syāt viyadādibhāvaḥ somatvavannāsti yato viśeṣaḥ | naivaṃ, na bhogo'sti yato'tra tasmāt sādṛśyamevātra na tattanutvam || 4 || āvrīhibhāvāt acirāt cirāt vā santiṣṭhate'yaṃ niyaterabhāvāt | naivaṃ viśaṃkyaṃ parato viśeṣāt "ato hi durniṣpataṃ" ityamuṣmāt || 5 || "jāyanta" ityeva viśeṣaśabdāt vrīhyādidehāstu bhavanti jīvāḥ | naitattu gauṇaṃ jananābhidhānaṃ taddhetvabhāvāt paratastu bhāvāt || 6 || bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ pariṣvaṅgaḥ karmaśeṣasahāyatā | apuṇyānāmanāroho viyadādisadṛkṣatā || 7 || tatrācirādavasthānaṃ vrīhyādeḥ śleṣaṇaṃ tathā | ityarthāḥ ṣaḍamī samyak pādenānena cintitāḥ || 8 || gamanāgamanaprakāracintā vihitopāsisiṣā prasiddhihetoḥ | na tu kaścana doṣamātmasaṃsthaṃ yadi nekṣeta tadā paraṃ hyupāste || 9 || guṇitvataḥ sannidhitaśca jīvaḥ svāpnārthakarteti na śaṃkyametat | asaṃbhavatvāt ahitakriyāyāḥ tirohitatvena guṇasya cāsya || 10 || śrutau viśeṣāgrahaṇāt suṣupteḥ nāḍyaḥ purītat paramo'thavā syāt | bhūmistvitīdaṃ na, vikalpadoṣāt prāsādakhaṭvāśayanādivat syāt || 11 || prāptyā parasyākhilakarmanāśāt anyaḥ praboddhā na punaḥ suṣuptaḥ | naivārthavattvāt vidhikarmaṇoḥ syāt anusmṛteḥ vyāghra iti śruteśca || 12 || prāṇasya sarvendriyasaṃhṛteśca vyāpārahānermaraṇaṃ tu mūrcchā | mugdhe'rdhalābho maraṇasya sā syāt ākāravaiṣamyasamutthitibhyām || 13 || ātmecchayā vā'pyatiheyabhāvāt pūyādisaṅgaḥ sa parasya doṣaḥ | tatsthānasaṃbandhitayeti, naitat sarvatra nirdoṣaguṇitvaśabdāt || 14 || nānātvaikatvayukteḥ pariṇamanamacittvena cet bādhitatvaṃ nirdoṣatvaśruteḥ syāt atha tadubhayayoreka sāmānyayogaḥ | naitat syānnaiva loke kvacidapi kathitaḥ khaṇḍaśabdena muṇḍaḥ tasmādaṃśatvamaṃśitvamapi hi jagato brahmaṇaścā''tmavat syāt || 15 || setutvavyapadeśato mitatayā saṃśabdanāt prāpakaśrutyā cāpi "tato yaduttarataraṃ" tvityeva bhedagrahāt | prāpyo'nyaḥ parato'pi kaściditi yannaitat tvasaṃbhedanāt dhyeyatvādapavargasādhanatayā hetutvasaṃśabdanāt || 16 || sākṣāt kramāt vā phaladatvadṛṣṭeḥ atrāpi karmaiva phalaṃ dadātu | naivedamanyārthatayā tu kipteḥ śrutismṛtibhyaśca sa eva datte || 17 || svapnaḥ suṣuptiḥ pratibodhanaṃ ca mūrcchā ca jīvasya, parasya cāpi | nirdoṣabhāvo jagadaṃśabhāvaḥ sarveśvaratvaṃ phaladātṛtā ca || 18 || nyāyaiścaturbhirādyaiḥ vicintitaḥ pūrvapādaśeṣastu | tasmādatra tu pāde susaṅgataṃ pañcamāt prabhṛti || 19 || sthānitvāt acidaikyāt avaratvāt aphaladatvācca | anupāsyam iti tu śaṅkāṃ śakalayati smauttaraiḥ caturbhiḥ iha || 20 || aviśeṣataḥ śrutatvāt prakaraṇabhedācca bhedinī vidyā | naivaṃ pratipattṝṇāṃ bhinnatvāt codanādyabhedācca || 21 || udgīthaikyaṃ codanāderabhedāt chandogānāṃ vājināṃ ceti naitat | udgīthāṃśodgīthayoḥ prāṇadṛṣṭyā rūpānaikyāt karmakartrostathā ca || 22 || prāṇasya jyaiṣṭhyādau satyapi na vasiṣṭhatādayaḥ kathitāḥ | bhedo rūpavibhedānnaitat syuste'pi taditarābhedāt || 23 || aprakaraṇapaṭhitatvāt ānandādyā guṇā na saṃgrāhyāḥ | sarvāsviti tu na śaṃkyaṃ, taistu vinā tannirūpaṇāśakteḥ || 24 || "ācāmet" iti vihitaṃ prāṇopāstyaṅgamanyadācamanam | naitat anūdya vidheyaṃ hyaprāpteḥ prāṇavāsastvam || 25 || saṃkalpasatyavaśitādyatirekāt virūpabhedato hyasyāḥ | bheda iti naiva yasmāt vaśitā saṅkalpasatyatāvitatiḥ || 26 || bhāsvaddhṛṣīkāsanayorupāsyābhedāt abhedāt ubhayāhvaye dve | na rūpabhedāt sthalajāt vibhinne vyavasthitaikāhvayane yathākramam || 27 || kiñcinnārabhyokteḥ dyuvyāptaḥ saṃbhṛtiśca vīryāṇām | sarvāsviti tu na yasmāt dyuvyāptirnālpadeśasaṃgrāhyā || 28 || vidyābhedaḥ satyapi saṃjñaikye puruṣavidyeti | "śaṃ no mitre"tyādyā mantrā vidyāṅgaṃ antikāmananāt | na hi, śukrādikamantravadadhyayanāṅgaṃ tathaiva sārmathyāt || 30 || puṇyādihānyupāyana ekaṃ cintyaṃ samuccitaṃ veha | pṛgāmnānaphalatvāt naitat sāpekṣataḥ parasparataḥ || 31 || puṇyādihānicintā gatyupapatteḥ mṛtau ca mārge ca | kāryeti naiva maraṇe kartavyā tāvadityukteḥ || 32 || tadvidyāniṣṭhānāṃ tadvidyoktārcirādigaticintā syāt | prakaraṇabhedānnaitat tadya iti tu samānatāvacanāt || 33 || vidyāviśeṣakathitāstvasthūlādyā bhavanti tatraiva | nānyatra mānahāneḥ naivānandādivannirūpakataḥ || 34 || praṣṭrorbhedo'pi tathā vyatihāraḥ prāṇanāśanāyādyoḥ | vākyaṃ sadvidyāvat "yat sākṣāt" iti samānataḥ praśne || 35 || ākāśatacchayānau samupāsyau yadi na daharavidyaikā | sāmānyāttu guṇānāṃ kvacidākāśasya hṛdayavācitvāt || 36 || udgīthasyopāstiḥ niyatā syāt aṅgavattadāśrayataḥ | aniyamanamarthavattvāt anupāsiturapi ca karmitāhetoḥ || 37 || sādhāraṇatvahetoḥ guṇī tu guṇacintaneṣu nārvatyaḥ | naivaṃ viśiṣṭabhedāt pratiguṇamāvartanīya eva guṇī || 38 || pūrvānuvākanītyā daharopāsti samupāsyanirṇayanam | prakṛtatvāditi naivaṃ svavākyabalataḥ samastanirṇayanam || 39 || avidheyaḥ svasya vidhau ca kriyāmayeṣṭakacitādivahnīnām | vākyāt kalpyavidhitvāt vidyāmayyo manaścitādyāḥ syuḥ || 40 || kartṛtvādiviśiṣṭo jīvo dhyeyaḥ śarīritāhetoḥ | naivaṃ guṇāṣṭakayutaḥ prāpyatvāt syāt yathākratunyāyāt || 41 || udgīthasyopāstiḥ niyatā svāsveva netarāsvamiteḥ | naivaṃ śaṃkyamupāsteḥ kevalamudgīthamātra viṣayatvāt || 42 || ubhayatra phalasamukteḥ vyasto vyastassamasto vā | vaiśvānaro vicintyaḥ naiva niṣedhāt samasta eva syāt || 43 || phalacodanādyabhedāt ekatvaṃ syāt sadādividyānām | naivaṃ saṃjñārūpaprabhedato bhinnataiva syāt || 44 || brahmānubhūtyapekṣā bāhulyāt syāt sadādividyānām | ekatraiva samuccitiriti naiva phalasya sarvathaivaikyāt || 45 || udgīthādyanucintananiyamābhāvastu naiva pūrvoktaḥ | aphalatvataḥ svavākye naiva tathāśrayavidheḥ phalitvācca || 46 || vidyaikyaṃ udgīthabhidā prāṇopāstyekatā tathā | ānandādisamāhāraḥ prāṇavāsastva codanam || 47 || śāṇḍilyaikyaṃ vyavasthā ca nāmnoḥ dyuvyāpanasya ca | vibhedaḥ puruṣopāsteḥ vedādyadhyayanāṅgatā || 48 || hānādyanyonyasambandhaḥ kālastaccintanāvidheḥ | sādhāraṇyaṃ saraṇyāśca tathā'sthūlādisāmyatā || 49 || prāṇāśanāyādyekatvaṃ tataśca daharaikatā | udgīthopāstyaniyamo guṇyāvṛttyanucintanam || 50 || sarvopāsyavinirṇītiḥ vidyātvaṃ ca manaścitām | jīvasya guṇitopāstiḥ sarvatrodgīthacintanam || 51 || vaiśvānarasya sāmastyaṃ sadvidyādervibhinnatā | vidyānāmasamāhāraḥ udgīthā'niyatiḥ punaḥ || 52 || bhedābhedau ca vidyānāṃ guṇānāṃ ca grahāgrahau | itthametena pādena sādhiṣṭhaṃ paricintitam || 53 || karmāṅgatvāt kartṛnirṇāyikāyāḥ vidyāyāstatkarma datte phalāni | naitajjīvādhīśa nirṇāyakatvāt vidyā datte karma cāṅgaṃ tvamuṣyāḥ || 54 || karmāṅgodgīthādisaṃbandhamātraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yasmāt tatstutitvaṃ rasādeḥ | nāsānnidhyāt tadvidheyaprakarṣāt aprāptatvāccātra kalpyo vidhiḥ syāt || 55 || pratardanādyāstu viśeṣasaṃjñāḥ pāriplavārthā viniyogahetoḥ | vidyāvidhārthāstu tadaikavākyāt manvādisaṃjñā caritārthanācca || 56 || vidyāstu yajñāditadaṅgahāneḥ pravrājakānāṃ na hi saṃbhavanti | naitat, "yadicchanta" iti śrutatvāt agnyādyapekṣārahitaiva sā'sti || 57 || sādhāraṇatvāt gṛhamedhināṃ ca pravrājivat sā tu tadaṅgahīnā | naivaṃ tu yajñādika vākyabhāvāt sarvatra ca svāśramadharmavattvāt || 58 || vyāpārakarmādhikṛtatvahetoḥ teṣāṃ tu vidyā na śamādiyuktā | naitat śamādestu tadaṅgabhāvāt dvayostayoḥ bhinnanibandhanatvāt || 59 || sarvānnabhuktistu viśeṣahāneḥ syāt sarvadā prāṇavidāṃ itīdam | na śobhate śaktiviśeṣabhājaḥ prāṇātyaye brahmavido'pi dṛṣṭeḥ || 60 || vidyāvihīnāśramakarmabhūtā yajñādayo naiva virodhabhāvāt | nityaṃ tadanyacca phalaṃ kathaṃ syāt naitatprasaṅgo viniyogabhedāt || 61 || yajñādikarmāṅgakalāpahāneḥ vidyādhikāro na nirāśramāṇām | tannaiva raikvādiṣu lakṣitatvāt japopavāsādyupakārataśca || 62 || japopavāsādyanumodabhāvāt vidyādhikāro viparicyutānām | naitat smṛteḥ tatparihārahānau sandarśanāt śiṣṭabahiṣkṛteśca || 63 || kratvaṅgasaṃbandhamupāsanaṃ yat tatsvāminaḥ tatphalabhoktṛbhāvāt | naivaÐtvajāṃ karma tadaṅgavat syāt karmāṅgasaṃbandhata eva hetoḥ || 64 || mantavya ityeva vidhānahetoḥ anūdyate maunaṃ iti tvasat syāt | maunaṃ prakṛṣṭe manane hi loke prasiddhyate tena vidheyametat || 65 || vidheyahāneḥ viduṣastu bālyaṃ sarvaṃ ca kāmācaraṇādi, naitat | viśeṣato "nāviratā"divākyaiḥ bālyaṃ tvanāviṣkaraṇaṃ kulādeḥ || 66 || yajñādikaṃ tvabhyudayādihetuḥ sadyaḥ phalaṃ syāt avilambahetoḥ | na tat baliṣṭhaiḥ pratibandhahānau tat syāt "yadeve"ti tu coditatvāt || 67 || niḥśreyasaikārthaṃ upāstikarma sadyaḥ phalaṃ syāt prabalatvahetoḥ | taccāpi na brahmavidagrimāṇāṃ nindādikasyātibalottaratvāt || 68 || vidyāyāḥ phaladātṛtvaṃ rasādeśca vidheyatā | vidyāṅgatā ca yajñānāṃ vidyā pravrājināṃ tathā || 69 || gṛhasthānāṃ ca vidyāyā yajñādipratyavekṣaṇam | teṣāṃ śamādyapekṣatvaṃ āhārasya vyavasthitiḥ || 70 || gārhasthyāpi karmatvaṃ yajñādeḥ karmaṇaḥ tathā | vidhurāṇāṃ adhikṛtiḥ cyutānāṃ tadvihīnatā || 71 || kratvaṅgopāsane ṛtvikkāryatā maunitāvidhiḥ | bālyaṃ tvasyāprakāśatvaṃ śakti vidyābhijanmanām || 72 || pratibandhe vilambitvaṃ svargamokṣārthakarmaṇoḥ | ityanenetikartavyasaṃhatiḥ paricintitā || 73 || jñānasyopāyatvāt tasya ca sakṛdeva kartumarhatvāt | sakṛdeva vedanaṃ syāt naitadupāstitvacodanāt jñapteḥ || 1 || svasmāt vibhedena paro hyupāsyaḥ bhedasya sarvatra samarthitatvāt | naivāhamityātmatayā hyupāsyaḥ "tvaṃ ve"ti śabdācca tadātmataśca || 2 || tathā pratīkeṣu yathetareṣu yasmāt paropāsanatā'viśiṣṭā | tannaiva śaṃkyaṃ, paramātmadṛṣṭyā nāmādikānāṃ samupāsyabhāvāt || 3 || udgīthadṛṣṭistapane tu nīce śreṣṭhaṃ hi karmaiva phalapradatvāt | tannaiva tasyāpi phalapradatvaṃ tatpūjanatvāditi nānyathā syāt || 4 || āsīna ityeva viśeṣahāneḥ sarvapravṛttiṣvapi sā vidheyā | syānnaivamaikāgryaviśeṣabhāvāt dhyānaśruteścopaniṣeduṣaḥ sā || 5 || śāstrārthanirvṛttita eva hetoḥ kartavyamekatra tu vāsare tat | etanna saṃsiddhyati "yāvadāyuḥ" ityeva śabdāt vidhitaśca tasya || 6 || "nābhuktaṃ" ityeva tu saṃsmṛtatvāt aśleṣanāśau na hi pātakānām | tasyāḥ phalitvaikasamarthanatvāt "evaṃ vidī"ti śravaṇācca naivam || 7 || aśleṣanāśau hitakarmaṇāṃ tu naiva prasaktau sukhalābhahetoḥ | tannaiva mokṣapratibandhakatvasāmyānmumukṣoḥ sphuṭataḥ prasaktau || 8 || sarvasya vaiśeṣikaśabdahāneḥ aśleṣanāśau bhavato hi tasya | nārabdhakāryasya hi naiva yasmāt "yāvanna mokṣye"ti viśeṣaśabdaḥ || 9 || aśleṣanāśaśravaṇāt kṛtānāṃ akāryatā svāśramakarmaṇāṃ ca | naitattu kāryaṃ khalu "yajña"śabdāt vidyāsamutpādanaśaktitaśca || 10 || "yāvanna mokṣye"ti viśeṣaśabdāt ārabhyamāṇasya phalaṃ ca karma | taddehapātāvadhikaṃ na caitat tasyāḥ śruteḥ tatphalagocaratvāt || 11 || asakṛt kāryatopāsteḥ ahamityapyupāsyatā | pratīkeṣvanyathopāstiḥ aṅgeṣvarkādidṛṣṭayaḥ || 12 || upāsterāsanāṅgatvaṃ pratyahaṃ cāpyupāsyatā | aghasyāśleṣanāśau ca puṇyasyāpi tathā bhavaḥ || 13 || ārabdhasya phalitvaṃ ca kāryatā''śramakarmaṇām | karmāvadhitvaṃ bandhasya pādenānena sādhitam || 14 || vāco manaḥ kāraṇakatvahāneḥ vṛtterlayaścetasi naiva vācaḥ | tannaiva tasyāśca samānabhāvāt vākchabdataḥ saṅgatimātrataśca || 15 || prāṇo'mbu tejaḥ prakṛtitvayogāt "āpomayaḥ prāṇaḥ" iti śruteśca | na syādahaṅkārakṛtaṃ tu cittaṃ prāṇo nabhaḥ kāryamataḥ sa eva || 16 || prāṇo bhavet tejasi yogabhāgī tathaiva śabdaśravaṇāt itīdam | na syāttu jīvopagamādiśabdāt prāṇasya, tejaḥ śravaṇaṃ tu paścāt || 17 || tejastu "tatteja" iti śrutatvāt tanmātramevānyaviyuktarūpam | na syāt tu bhūtāntarasaṃpraviṣṭaṃ trivṛtkṛtatva śravaṇādaśakteḥ || 18 || eṣā tvavidyasya gatirbhavitrī vidyāvato'traiva parāptiśabdāt | naitat dvayaṃ syāt ubhayoḥ samānā gatiḥ śarīrāt itaro'rthavādaḥ || 19 || bhogādyabhāvena nirarthakatvāt yathāyathaṃ syurna tu devatāyām | saṃyanti tānīti na śaṃkyametat "tejaḥ parasyāṃ" iti coditatvāt || 20 || teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu paratra puṃsi svakāraṇatvāt pralayastu bhāvī | tannaiva pūrvaiḥ sphuṭamekavākyāt saṃśleṣamātraṃ tadabādhataśca || 21 || mūrdhā'nyanāḍībhiriti vyavasthā na saukṣmyataḥ saṃbhavaśaṃsi vākyam | tannaiva vidyāmahimātirekāt paraprasatteśca tathaiva yānam || 22 || niśāmṛtau raśmyanusāravāraṇe naiva vyavasthā kiraṇānusāre | na tadvyavasthaiva bhavenniśīthe'pyauṣṇyopalabdheḥ yadamī hi santi || 23 || divā mṛtasyaiva paropasattiḥ vigarhitatvānmaraṇasya rātrau | na syādidaṃ bandhakakarmahānāt vidyābalāt tāṃ vadati śrutiśca || 24 || mṛtasya muktirna hi dakṣiṇāyane śaśāṅkasāyujyaṃ amuṣya hi śrutam | na tattu vidyā mahimātirekataḥ śrutistu sā viśramabhūmigocarā || 25 || vāk tu cetasi tat prāṇe tat punarjīvacetasoḥ (tejasoḥ) | tejasaścetaraśleṣaḥ tāvanmātrasya tulyatā || 26 || teṣāṃ parasmin gamanaṃ tasya ca śleṣamātratā | mūrdhanyanāḍīniyamo raśmineti vyavasthitiḥ || 27 || niśāyāṃ cāpi sanmokṣo mokṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyane | ityetat sarvaṃ etena pādenātra vicintitam || 28 || tṛtīya pādaḥ śākhāsu bahuvidhatvāt gatiśruterarcirādiniyamo na | tannaiva niyamanaṃ syāt sarvatrārkādi cihnasaṃbhavataḥ || 29 || vāyuśca devalokaḥ śabdavibhedāt pṛthagbhavataḥ | na syāt "yo'yaṃ pavate sa devalokaḥ" iti tadviśeṣaṇataḥ || 30 || śrutibhaṅge'pyagatitvāt pāṭhāt vāyoḥ pare tu varuṇādyāḥ | tannārthavaśādvaruṇaḥ taṭitaḥ syāt upari taduparīndrādyāḥ || 31 || upadeśasya tathātvāt cihnāni tvarcirādayaḥ saraṇeḥ | naitat gamayitṛśabdāt upari pare'pyātivāhikā hi syuḥ || 32 || caturmukhamupāsituḥ gatiriyaṃ sa hi prāpyate parasya paripūrṇataḥ satatameva saṃprāptitaḥ | na tatparamupāsituḥ śrutita eva taccāpyasat paraṃ tadanujīvamapyubhayataḥ śruterdarśanāt || 33 || arcirādestu niyamo vāyoḥ svargasya caikatā | taṭito varuṇaprāptiḥ ātivāhikatā tataḥ || 34 || phalaṃ jīvaparopāstyoḥ arcirādigatistviyam | iti sarvamanenaiva pādena paricintitam || 35 || nityopalabdherasukhatvataśca kenāpi rūpeṇa sukhaikabhājā | muktasya saṃbandha iti tvasat syāt sveneti śabdāt atirohitatvāt || 36 || parānubhūtistu vibhedataḥ syāt sādharmyaśabdādatisāmyaśabdāt | na syādidaṃ nāma tadātmakatvāt sāmyaśrutistadguṇasāmyalambā || 37 || muktasvarūpaṃ tu guṇāṣṭakaṃ syāt tathā śrutatvāt dyutimātratā vā | tasyaiva vijñānaghanatvaśabdāt tannobhayaṃ syāt ubhayāvirodhāt || 38 || muktasya pitrādi tu saprayatnāt saṅkalpato bhāvi tathaiva dṛṣṭeḥ | brahmādikeṣvityasadetat eṣāṃ saṅkalpasatyatvaviyogataḥ syāt || 39 || mukto'śarīrastvaśarīraśabdāt icchāśarīrī "bahudhā" iti śabdāt | naiṣā vyavasthā "bahudhā" tu śabdāt bahuśruteśca tvayamaicchikaḥ syāt || 40 || muktasya bhogaḥ khalu sāmyaśabdāt nirvoḍhṛtā syāt bhuvanasya tadvat | naitat parasyaiva tathātvaśabdāt bhogonubhūtiḥ saguṇasya tasya || 41 || āvirbhavatsvarūpatvaṃ parānubhavarūpaṇam | muktasvarūpaniṣkarṣaḥ satyasaṅkalpatā tathā || 42 || svecchayā sarvasaṃbhogaḥ mokṣasya ca phalodayaḥ | ityevamarthajātaṃ syāt pādenānena cintitam || 43 ||
